title: Replace Go lint suppressions with documented exceptions
notes: The Go baseline prohibits inline lint suppressions, but the port has 38 directives across 23 files. The gate currently accepts them.
done_when: Audit the current directives, remove those that can be addressed without suppressions, and record justified exceptions in the applicable checked-in configuration.
result: Replace Go lint suppressions with documented exceptions
